title: Analysis of Coburn's toe implant: skewed isotopes and nanotech

tellings.quote: Then um he got funding from Haime Masan to uh to remove it a few months later and um he didn't have anybody to analyze it. So um where I was working at the time I had I had [clears throat] access to a lot of analyt analytical equipment.

plain: A scientist named Steve Coburn, who studies small objects people believe aliens put inside their bodies, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about one found in someone's toe in California. He says it was removed with funding from a man named Jaime Maussan, and since nobody else was available to study it, Coburn used the lab equipment at his workplace and later wrote a paper on it. According to Coburn, the object showed unusual mixes of isotopes, meaning versions of chemical elements not found in normal ratios, and signs of tiny engineered structures, which would point to something not made on Earth.
